entries.name: claude-task-output-scope-posttool-tests

entries.nonOverlapNote: Distinct from passive reader enforcement and agent-controlled output text

entries.name: audit-pack-tests

entries.nonOverlapNote: Audit packaging does not publish or create approval proof

entries.name: clone-hook-readiness-tests

entries.nonOverlapNote: Readiness diagnosis is distinct from installation and activation

entries.name: design-authoring-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Design authoring creates visibly draft material and compact, digest-bound readback
entries.nonOverlapNote: Authoring helpers do not grant architecture approval or implementation authority

entries.name: install-snapshot-progress-tests

entries.nonOverlapNote: Progress and snapshot integrity checks do not change hook ownership rules

entries.name: model-family-approval-request-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Model-family approval requests bind available routes and preserve fail-closed proof verification
entries.nonOverlapNote: Request preview is separate from human signature and activation

entries.name: claude-intake-prompt-capture-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Claude prompt references disclose only consented, bounded native capture text
entries.nonOverlapNote: Private capture readers do not broaden transcript or task-output path access

entries.name: claude-intake-prompt-hook-tests
entries.invariantPinned: UserPromptSubmit capture emits only opaque references and keeps pre-consent content private
entries.nonOverlapNote: The hook producer does not itself approve or apply captured intake

entries.name: bound-design-line-endings-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Line-ending remediation is bound to the exact repository and preserves signed LF checkout bytes
entries.nonOverlapNote: The helper does not rewrite design content or project-wide configuration

entries.name: claude-native-capture-entry-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Agent-invoked native capture producers are denied while passive reads remain unchanged
entries.nonOverlapNote: Entry denial is separate from native host hook provenance

entries.name: runtime-handover-projection-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Runtime handover projection binds current Git state without rewriting tracked bytes
entries.nonOverlapNote: Projection authority does not alter or attest handover content

entries.name: runtime-handover-writer-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Runtime handover writer preserves tracked state and refuses lifecycle drift
entries.nonOverlapNote: Private projection does not overwrite operator-authored handover material

entries.name: claude-intake-reference-admission-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Native intake references are admitted only at the published shared argv boundary
entries.nonOverlapNote: Reference admission does not grant consent or resolve arbitrary paths

entries.name: design-workflow-package-builder-tests
entries.invariantPinned: V2 design workflow packages are built from canonically verified preparation and readiness evidence
entries.nonOverlapNote: Package creation does not request PO approval or grant implementation authority

entries.name: design-course-coordinator-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Course inspection reports runner readiness and typed native Advisor unavailability
entries.nonOverlapNote: Inspection remains read-only and grants no implementation authority

entries.name: design-course-session-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Design-course stages preserve canonical Advisor routing and signed-package authority boundaries
entries.nonOverlapNote: Course session helpers do not grant implementation authority or PO approval

entries.name: design-course-command-admission-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Design-course guard admission binds exact current feature, sources and dispatch; agent profile-change apply and stale or malformed producer commands fail closed
entries.nonOverlapNote: Command admission exercises the guard boundary independently of coordinator execution and does not grant PO approval or implementation authority

entries.name: guard-dispatch-budget-checkpoint-tests
entries.invariantPinned: The dispatch-budget hook emits the checkpoint notice at exactly ceil(0.8 x cap) and on the last three working calls, hands the closing lane back only to the Critic, never notifies or counts the orchestrator, and bounds every granted cap by maxTurns minus the closing allowance minus one
entries.nonOverlapNote: Exercises the real hook child process and the pure grant core black-box and imports no guard module; it is additive to guard-dispatch-budget-tests, whose module-scope-import hazard it avoids

entries.name: git-hook-runtime-snapshot-fast-verify-tests
entries.invariantPinned: The fast verification paths of the git-hook runtime snapshot (batched native DACL read, below-root lstat walk, in-process verified memo) never weaken its refusals of tampered content, planted links or junctions, foreign ACEs and source drift, and the source tree is re-read and hashed in full
entries.nonOverlapNote: Pins only the security properties of the fast verification paths; fixtures live under the OS temp dir and every planted ACE, junction or tamper is removed before a test ends

entries.name: project-onboarding-foreign-residue-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Session readiness depends only on the requesting session's own descriptor: foreign descriptors (killed or stopped Verify incidents, bare orphans) yield a ready result carrying one admitted cleanup_residue_foreign warning and are never touched, while the requester's own descriptor with retained resources keeps the non-ready result
entries.nonOverlapNote: Readiness-level case on incident-shaped descriptors in a throw-away fixture repository; distinct from the unit-level foreign-residue decision pinned by project-onboarding-foreign-residue-unit-tests

entries.name: project-onboarding-foreign-residue-unit-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Whether retained session residue is foreign is decided against real session descriptors: a foreign descriptor (incident shapes, with or without resources) is a warning and never a lock, the requester's own descriptor decides, and no descriptor or an unreadable inventory yields no warning (fail closed)
entries.nonOverlapNote: Unit-level decision against real descriptors in a throw-away git fixture; it needs no onboarding fixture and is distinct from the readiness-level case in project-onboarding-foreign-residue.test.mjs

entries.name: verify-run-record-tests
entries.invariantPinned: A Verify run records its cleanup duty in a run record and never in a session descriptor or session-cleanup state, the record carries PID and start evidence, an abort settles it and drains the unsealed run directory, and a stale record of a dead PID is swept without a signature while live and sealed runs are respected
entries.nonOverlapNote: Pins the run-record cleanup contract only; session-descriptor and worktree behavior stay pinned by worktree-lifecycle-tests

entries.name: test-private-tmp-tests
entries.invariantPinned: One owner-only, non-inheriting private temp root is the single placement for test fixtures, so private-state assurance never has to be loosened for tests
entries.nonOverlapNote: Unique API contract suite for test-private-tmp.mjs

entries.name: scratch-retention-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Read-only scratch durability assessment and sweep plan never delete anything and keep referenced scratch content
entries.nonOverlapNote: Pure planning contract (sprint-alfred slice C-S1); applying a plan is covered by scratch-sweep-tests

entries.name: scratch-sweep-tests
entries.invariantPinned: The scratch-sweep CLI check mode emits one exact JSON report and its explicit sweep mode applies only the planned deletions
entries.nonOverlapNote: CLI front-end coverage (sprint-alfred slice C-S2) distinct from the pure planning suite scratch-retention-tests

entries.name: design-consistency-check-tests
entries.invariantPinned: ADR-0085 U1 design consistency check is pure, deterministic and reports every review-chain inconsistency under its code
entries.nonOverlapNote: Unique pure in-memory U1 contract suite; receipt creation and approval binding are separate suites

entries.name: design-review-receipt-tests
entries.invariantPinned: ADR-0085 U2 design review receipts are created and summarized deterministically from canonical bytes with the import rule respected
entries.nonOverlapNote: Unique U2 receipt contract suite, distinct from the U1 consistency check and the U3 approval binding

entries.name: design-approval-binding-tests
entries.invariantPinned: ADR-0085 U3 approval binding verifies real U2 receipts against the real U1 chain check and refuses with typed codes
entries.nonOverlapNote: Unique U3 binding contract suite; it composes the real U1 and U2 modules rather than duplicating their suites

entries.name: recovery-refusal-registry-tests
entries.invariantPinned: Every refusal code has a registered recovery disposition and unregistered codes are found
entries.nonOverlapNote: Unique registry completeness and lookup suite for recovery-refusal-registry.mjs

entries.name: attended-recovery-tests
entries.invariantPinned: The attended-recovery verifier accepts only a package whose repository identity, out-of-repository anchor, signature binding and artifact bytes all hold, and refuses every forgery with a typed ATR code
entries.nonOverlapNote: Unique suite for harness/scripts/attended-recovery.mjs (RV-S7)

entries.name: agy-central-snapshot-tests

entries.name: critic-lane-fallback-tests

entries.name: fs-durability-tests
